title: Right now
grammar: Present Continuous (I'm working / Are you…? / What are you doing?) + this / that / these / those
today: Hoje você vai aprender a contar o que está acontecendo AGORA e a apontar as coisas perto e longe: this, that, these, those.
canDo: Dizer o que você está fazendo agora: I'm buying this jacket.
Perguntar What are you doing? e Are you…ing?
Apontar perto e longe: this / these, that / those
Descrever roupas e cores: He's wearing those orange pants.

video.context: Os amigos se ligam e perguntam o que cada um está fazendo naquele momento.
video.predict: Se alguém te liga agora e pergunta “What are you doing?”, o que você responde?

audio.title: The Man in the Orange Pants

lines.text: It's Sunday at 4. Tony and Jenny are at a clothes store. Tony is wearing orange pants and a green hat today.
Tony, what are you doing?
I'm looking at these shoes. They're 80 dollars.
Nice! I'm buying this blue jacket.
Jenny, **look at** that man over there! He's wearing those orange pants and that green hat.
Hmm... and he's looking at you, Tony.
Ugh! Those pants are horrible!
Tony is dancing. The man is dancing too.
**Well**, Tony... that's a mirror. That man is you!

options: The man in the orange pants is Tony.

chunks.tip: Olhar PRA alguma coisa = LOOK AT. Sempre com o AT! Look at that man! = Olha aquele cara! E no continuous: I'm looking at these shoes.
examples: Jenny, look at that man over there!
And he's looking at you, Tony.

alt: I am looking at these apples.

practice.en: Rosa, look at that dog over there!

practice.pt: E ela está olhando pra você, Carlos.
practice.en: And she's looking at you, Carlos.
alt: And she is looking at you, Carlos.

chunks.tip: Roupa no corpo é WEAR, nunca "use"! He's wearing a hat = ele está de chapéu. Junta com as cores que você já sabe: orange pants, green hat.
examples: Tony is wearing orange pants and a green hat today.

practice.pt: A Jenny está usando uma jaqueta azul hoje.
practice.en: Jenny is wearing a blue jacket today.
alt: Jenny's wearing a blue jacket today.

practice.pt: Ele está usando aquelas calças pretas.
alt: He is wearing those black pants.

practice.pt: Ela está usando aquele chapéu vermelho.
alt: She is wearing that red hat.

chunks.chunk: I'm buying / What are you doing?
chunks.pt: estou comprando / o que você está fazendo?
chunks.tip: Present continuous é o AGORA: am / is / are + verbo com -ING. I'm buying, he's dancing. Pra perguntar, inverte: What ARE you doing? Are you working?
examples: Tony is dancing. The man is dancing too.

practice.pt: Carlos, o que você está fazendo?
Eu estou comprando esta jaqueta vermelha.
alt: I am buying this red jacket.

practice.pt: A Rosa está dançando. O Max está dançando também.
practice.en: Rosa is dancing. Max is dancing too.
alt: Rosa's dancing. Max is dancing too.

chunks.tip: Perto de você: THIS (um) e THESE (vários). Longe: THAT (um) e THOSE (vários). Pants e shoes são sempre plural, então é THOSE pants, THESE shoes.
examples: He's wearing those orange pants and that green hat.

alt: I am looking at these hats.

practice.pt: Eu estou comprando este chapéu verde.
alt: I am buying this green hat.

practice.pt: Ele está usando aqueles sapatos e aquela jaqueta.
practice.en: He's wearing those shoes and that jacket.
alt: He is wearing those shoes and that jacket.

chunks.tip: Mirror (espelho) se fala "MÍ-rer". E repara: THAT'S = that is, pra apontar uma coisa lá longe. That man is you! = Aquele cara é você!
examples: That man in the mirror is you!
Tony is dancing in front of the mirror.

practice.pt: Aquela mulher no espelho é a Jenny!
practice.en: That woman in the mirror is Jenny!

practice.pt: O Max está dançando na frente do espelho.
practice.en: Max is dancing in front of the mirror.
alt: Max's dancing in front of the mirror.

grammar.title: Como funciona
rows: Ela está dançando. / Eles estão dançando.
He isn't working. / I'm not cooking.
Ele não está trabalhando. / Eu não estou cozinhando.
Are you working? — Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Você está trabalhando? — Estou. / Não estou.
grammar.tip: AGORA = am / is / are + verbo-ING. Rotina continua no simple present (I work every day), mas o que está rolando neste momento é continuous (I'm working now). E pra apontar: perto é this/these, longe é that/those. Falou, validou! 🚀

gossips.title: Sam Is Studying... or Not?

lines.text: It's Tuesday at 8 p.m. Rosa is at work. She calls Sam.
Hi, Sam! What are you doing?
I'm studying, Mom. Math and English.
But Lily, 8, is next to Sam.
Mom, he isn't studying! He's playing that zombie game!
Sam! Are you playing video games?
**Well**... yes. Only for 10 minutes.
And you, Lily? What are you doing?
Me? I'm eating this chocolate cake. It's your cake, Mom!
**Anyway**, now Sam is studying. And Lily? She's eating the cake under her bed.

options: Sam isn't studying. He's playing a game.

retell.prompt: Reconte a fofoca com as suas palavras. Comece com: "The story is about…"

gossips.title: Max and the White Socks

lines.text: It's Wednesday at 2. Carlos is working. Tony calls him.
Carlos! Max is running behind the building!
What? Is he wearing his red jacket?
No. He's wearing Jenny's white socks... on his head!
Oh no. What is Jenny doing?
She's running too. She isn't happy.
Now Max is under Tony's car. Jenny has those socks now.
Tony! These socks aren't white now. They're brown!
**Well**... how much are they, Jenny?
They're 12 dollars. **By the way**, Tony... Max is eating your shoe!

options: Max is running with Jenny's socks.
Carlos asks: how much are they?

questions.q: What color are the socks now?

realtimes.title: Domingo de manhã no prédio
realtimes.pt: É domingo, 10 da manhã. O Tony está na sala, ao lado da TV. Ele está olhando os vizinhos. A Jenny está correndo. Ela está usando aquela jaqueta vermelha. O Carlos não está trabalhando hoje: ele está dormindo no sofá. E o Max? O Max está aqui na cozinha do Tony, comendo estas bananas!
realtimes.model: It's Sunday, 10 a.m. Tony is in the living room, next to the TV. He's looking at the neighbors. Jenny is running. She's wearing that red jacket. Carlos isn't working today: he's sleeping on the couch. And Max? Max is here in Tony's kitchen, eating these bananas!

realtimes.title: Sete da noite lá em casa
realtimes.pt: Agora são 7 da noite. Eu estou na cozinha. Eu não estou cozinhando: eu estou comendo uma pizza. O meu irmão está jogando video game no quarto. O meu pai está dormindo no sofá. A minha mãe está dançando na sala. Ela está usando aquele chapéu verde horrível. E você? O que você está fazendo agora?
realtimes.model: It's 7 p.m. now. I'm in the kitchen. I'm not cooking: I'm eating a pizza. My brother is playing video games in his bedroom. My dad is sleeping on the couch. My mom is dancing in the living room. She's wearing that horrible green hat. And you? What are you doing now?
